beats.shot: side view of Kai over a loaded barbell
beats.does: grips the bar with his lower back rounded like a C
beats.says: Round your lower back to reach the bar.

beats.does: yanks the bar up by bending his elbows and pulling with his arms
beats.says: Pull it up with your arms.

beats.does: jerks the bar to his hips with his back still rounded
beats.says: Jerk it fast so it feels lighter.

beats.does: drops the bar from hip height

beats.says: That is how you pull heavy.
